protocol.baseline: development selection.json baseline, never selected from confirmation
protocol.population: Every transfer case in confirmation case_manifest.json in its saved order; fail on missing or duplicate arms; never discard failed outcomes
protocol.cluster_assignment: Zero-based transfer case index modulo 12; each cluster contributes one mean runtime-cost difference
protocol.paired_value: Negative complete elapsed runtime seconds multiplied by USD 3.52 / 3600; quality equivalence required separately
protocol.proxy_scope: Sourced equipment service-rate proxy; neither measured cloud tariff nor provider invoice. CPU seconds are separately observed and never substituted for elapsed seconds.
protocol.inference: One-sided 95 percent Student-t lower bound over the twelve cluster mean deltas; conditional on independent case generation and this proxy; no distribution-free guarantee
protocol.forecast_basis: Explicit prospective reuse scenario, fixed before confirmation; not observed demand or forecast accuracy
protocol.acceptance: All candidate and baseline confirmation transfer outcomes must pass the independently specified acceptance condition; no net-value claim may be made from rejected outputs
protocol.monetary_precision: Decimal arithmetic retains the input JSON decimal values. The unchanged upstream gate only supports integer cents: project baseline cost down and candidate cost up, then negate costs. Never round a positive advantage into existence.
protocol.incremental_costs: B includes measured assessment subtotal plus economic_protocol retention_assessment_usd, retention_packaging_usd and sharing_admission_usd. C for v2 includes measured extra Gym plus economic_protocol gym_development_usd. v1 has no additional Gym. Founder development is A and is not charged again. Each candidate is an alternative decision, not summed campaign expenditure.
protocol.actual_research_ledger: Each measured activity enters one A/B/C bucket only; labor, model authoring, untimed orchestration and actual hosting bills remain unknown. No complete real profit or earned revenue claim.
protocol.conformance_control: A separate synthetic positive monetary fixture encrypts and transfers the real v2 bytes. B executes those returned bytes on the first saved transfer case and compares the archived solution. This is post-confirmation replay, not independent economic admission or another fresh trial.
protocol.ordinary_library: Same local artifact bytes, authorized members and operation rights, with matching revocation state. Compare content hashes and allow/deny decisions; do not infer graph search or efficiency superiority.
protocol.enterprise_exemplar: At most one selected reference world 900000, shared_gym_composition policy, replayed through the native ledger. The ensemble runs its own simulator accounting; never label the entire ensemble native replay.
